name: Grishnákh, Brash Instigator — the target is bounded by the amassed Army's power at fire time
notes: "When Grishnákh enters, amass Orcs 2. When you do, until end of turn, gain control of target nonlegendary creature an opponent controls with power less than or equal to the amassed Army's power. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn." (2026-10-18) The site does not amass: the Orc Army and its +1/+1 counters are put on before the ability is fired (Conor: it reads the snapshot), and picked as the "Amassed Army". With a 2/2 Army the picker lists Grizzly Bears and Llanowar Elves, not Hill Giant (3) or the legendary Isamaru. Before, the comparison was a required subtype and the list was empty.
